SELECT T3.year, T3.name, T3.date, T3.time FROM drivers AS T1 INNER JOIN qualifying AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId INNER JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.date = (SELECT MIN(races.date) FROM qualifying JOIN races ON qualifying.raceId = races.raceId WHERE qualifying.driverId = T1.driverId) ORDER BY T1.dob DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM drivers d INNER JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId WHERE d.nationality = 'German' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985 GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname ORDER BY CAST(SUM(p.duration) AS REAL) / COUNT(p.duration) ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, res.time FROM races r INNER JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId INNER JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND res.positionOrder = 1

SELECT constructors.constructorRef, constructors.url FROM results JOIN constructors ON results.constructorId = constructors.constructorId WHERE results.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009 AND name = 'Singapore Grand Prix') AND results.time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009 AND name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'))

SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Match AS M JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE L.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND M.season = '2009/2010' AND M.away_team_goal > M.home_team_goal GROUP BY M.away_team_api_id, T.team_long_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY team_api_id ORDER BY MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT T2.name FROM Match AS T1 INNER JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T1.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY T2.id, T2.name ORDER BY SUM(T1.home_team_goal = T1.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.team_long_name FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '2012' AND T2.buildUpPlayPassing > (SELECT CAST(SUM(buildUpPlayPassing) AS REAL) / COUNT(team_long_name) FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', Team_Attributes.date) = '2012' AND buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL)

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.birthday, 1, 4) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT CAST(SUM(T2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.player_fifa_api_id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_fifa_api_id = T2.player_fifa_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

SELECT L.name FROM League L INNER JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2009/2010' GROUP BY L.id, L.name HAVING CAST(SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id) > CAST(SUM(M.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id)
SELECT CAST(SUM(M.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT M.id) FROM Match AS M INNER JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id WHERE C.name = 'Poland' AND M.season = '2010/2011'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') ORDER BY birthday ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.volleys > 70 AND T2.dribbling > 70

SELECT ((SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk') - (SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Paulin Puel')) * 100.0 / (SELECT AVG(T2.overall_rating) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Paulin Puel') AS percentage_higher
SELECT T2.overall_rating FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND T2.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'
SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient' AND Team_Attributes.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T2.team_short_name FROM Team_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Team AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT DISTINCT T2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id WHERE T1.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT T2.finishing, T2.curve FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player) ORDER BY T2.date DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Team.team_long_name FROM Match JOIN Team ON Match.away_team_api_id = Team.team_api_id ORDER BY Match.away_team_goal DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT Player.player_name FROM Player INNER JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id WHERE Player_Attributes.overall_rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Player_Attributes.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS ratio FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Diagnosis FROM Patient INNER JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 2

SELECT (SELECT MAX(L.Date) FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.ID = Patient.ID) AS `Lab Date`, (strftime('%Y', Patient.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS AgeAtArrival FROM Patient WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'SJS' ORDER BY Patient.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) - CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)) / CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS decrease_rate FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT CASE WHEN ((SELECT T2.UA FROM Laboratory AS T2 INNER JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.ID = 57266 AND T3.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA > 8.0) IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT T2.UA FROM Laboratory AS T2 INNER JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T2.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.ID = 57266 AND T3.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA > 6.5) IS NOT NULL) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_within_normal_range
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.UN = 29

SELECT CAST(SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, CAST((strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS INTEGER) AS age FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU >= 180 AND T2.`T-CHO` < 250

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, (CAST(strftime('%Y', datetime('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age, P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.RBC < 3.5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.ID = P.ID AND L.WBC > 3.5 AND L.WBC < 9.0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS L WHERE L.ID = P.ID AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGA > 80 AND T2.IGA < 500 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', T1."First Date") AS INTEGER) >= 1990
SELECT T2.Diagnosis FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE (T1.IGM <= 40 OR T1.IGM >= 400) GROUP BY T2.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND (strftime('%Y', DATE('now')) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.SSB IN ('-', '+-')
SELECT Patient.Birthday FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60 ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.ID = T1.ID AND T2.CPK < 250 AND T2.CPK IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID AND (T3.KCT = '+' OR T3.RVVT = '+' OR T3.LAC = '+'))
SELECT major.major_name FROM major JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major WHERE member.first_name = 'Angela' AND member.last_name = 'Sanders'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN COALESCE(T2.spent, 0) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN COALESCE(T2.spent, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM event AS T1 LEFT JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
SELECT major.department FROM member INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'President'
SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY T2.spent / T2.amount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget
SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT DISTINCT member.first_name, member.last_name FROM event INNER JOIN budget ON event.event_id = budget.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense ON budget.budget_id = expense.link_to_budget INNER JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE event.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'

SELECT (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T3.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T1.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.cost)) AS percentage FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM attendance AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T1.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T2.first_name = 'Maya' AND T2.last_name = 'Mclean' AND T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' )
SELECT T1.event_name FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.status = 'Closed' AND T2.remaining < 0 ORDER BY T2.remaining ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT `budget`.`category`, SUM(`expense`.`cost`) AS total_value FROM `expense` JOIN `budget` ON `expense`.`link_to_budget` = `budget`.`budget_id` JOIN `event` ON `budget`.`link_to_event` = `event`.`event_id` WHERE `event`.`event_name` = 'October Meeting' AND `expense`.`approved` = 'true' GROUP BY `budget`.`category`
SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT first_name, last_name, COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS total_cost FROM member LEFT JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member WHERE member.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' GROUP BY member.member_id, first_name, last_name
SELECT expense_description FROM expense JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE first_name = 'Sacha' AND last_name = 'Harrison'
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'
SELECT first_name, last_name, amount FROM income INNER JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' AND T2.Segment = 'LAM' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T1.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG(T1.Consumption) / 12 FROM yearmonth AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Segment = 'SME' AND T1.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Difference FROM yearmonth y INNER JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
SELECT SUBSTR(t1.Date, 1, 4) AS year FROM yearmonth AS t1 INNER JOIN customers AS t2 ON t1.CustomerID = t2.CustomerID WHERE t2.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY year ORDER BY SUM(t1.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(ym.Date, 5, 2) AS PeakMonth FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312' GROUP BY PeakMonth ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Discount' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM gasstations
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT DISTINCT products.Description FROM yearmonth INNER JOIN transactions_1k ON yearmonth.CustomerID = transactions_1k.CustomerID AND STRFTIME('%Y%m', transactions_1k.Date) = yearmonth.Date INNER JOIN products ON transactions_1k.ProductID = products.ProductID WHERE yearmonth.Date = '201309'
SELECT DISTINCT gs.Country FROM yearmonth ym JOIN transactions_1k t ON ym.CustomerID = t.CustomerID JOIN gasstations gs ON t.GasStationID = gs.GasStationID WHERE ym.Date = '201306'

SELECT DISTINCT products.Description FROM gasstations INNER JOIN transactions_1k ON gasstations.GasStationID = transactions_1k.GasStationID INNER JOIN products ON transactions_1k.ProductID = products.ProductID WHERE gasstations.Country = 'CZE'
SELECT T2.Segment FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-23' AND T1.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactions_1k AS t1 JOIN gasstations AS t2 ON t1.GasStationID = t2.GasStationID WHERE t1.Date = '2012-08-26' AND t1.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00' AND t2.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(c.Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25') AS t JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 1.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate FROM yearmonth ym WHERE ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8)
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Segment = 'Premium', 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Segment) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK'
SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_spent, SUM(CASE WHEN Date = '201201' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS jan_2012_spent FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 38508

SELECT T1.CustomerID, SUM(T1.Price) / SUM(T1.Amount) AS average_price_per_item, T2.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID GROUP BY T1.CustomerID, T2.Currency ORDER BY SUM(T1.Price) DESC LIMIT 1
